problems.what: at phone width the landscape type is about 8 px even inside the 1.4x push-in, the vertical about 10 px: the command, the found slot and the booked line cannot be read in phone.png
problems.fix: drop the 80/48-column grid: a 40-column grid of 66 px type in the landscape and a 30-column grid of 50 px type in the vertical, with the buffer scrolling so only the lines that matter are on the glass

problems.what: a 9.1 s calm: the power-on, then a boot log and a typed command that each add one small line at a time; nothing lands with a punch until the week opens at 11 s
problems.fix: a large grid-drawn ORIEL banner slams in on the beat at 1 s, and the buffer snap-scrolls at the prompt (4.5 s)

problems.what: the hook is only the power-on; the first words ('ORIEL/TTY 0.9') arrive at 2.0 s and are about 6 px on a phone
problems.fix: the banner lands at 1.0 s, readable at any size

problems.what: the terminal fills from the top, so the lower half of the glass (two-thirds in the vertical) is empty through the boot, the command and the booking

problems.what: the per-section camera changes its focus point, so the whole monitor jumps up and down the frame between sections and the bezel edges wander; it reads as an unsteady mount, not a push-in
problems.fix: a fixed monitor with only a small zoom drift; bigger type replaces the push-ins

problems.what: the found slot is one thin row among thirty and its arrow is one small cell in the margin
problems.fix: a full-width accent band, '14:00' in the label column beside it, and the message in large type
